title: Critique: absent qualia, the China brain duplicates the organization without the feel

statements.text: Block imagines the population of China recruited to duplicate a person's functional organization, with radio links and an artificial body. Such a homunculi-headed system would have no mental states with qualitative character, so there could be states functionally equivalent to sensations that lack their feel.

sources.quote: Block argues that such a “homunculi-headed” system would not have mental states with any qualitative character
